cueList.note: Fx tracking-in: the big line spreads in from tight letters.
Fx spring-in: three tool chips (editor, timeline, audio) bounce in, each with a colour pictogram.
The chips are struck through and sink; "a lost weekend" pops in the accent colour.
Fx expand-morph: the chips grow into the chat card. Whoosh.
Fx strikethrough-replace: "Three tools. A lost weekend." becomes "One conversation." A chat Lottie plays; the bubbles rise.
Folder tree card with an animated folder icon.
Chips: Claude Code, Codex, with an animated bot icon.
Fx connector-lines join the six stages; a check mark pops on each.
Chapter title: What you need, with an animated cog icon.
Required list: Linux, Python 3.12, FFmpeg.
Last required row: Claude Code or Codex.
Fx whip-pan to the next view. Fx terminal types /vf-setup.
Terminal prints the real doctor rows as OK; fx progress-bar fills the install.
Test video card springs in; a check-mark Lottie plays.
Zoom-through target: eight option cards, all dim.
Whisper card lights up with an animated icon; fx slot-roll shows the real time of one word of this video.
ElevenLabs card lights up; a live voice wave runs.
Pexels, Pixabay and Unsplash cards light up with animated icons.
Three stock photos rise in next to the cards.
Earshot card lights up; a live level meter runs.
Node card lights up; a HyperFrames 3D cube clip (cube-3d) plays.
Brainstormform card lights up.
The form address rises from the card.
Fx zoom-through into the big question. Fx masked-slide-reveal on the words.
Fx terminal types /vf.
The terminal reads brands, videos and stages; fx notification-stack lands a "Next step" toast.
Fx masked-slide-reveal: the full command list, line by line. Fx blinds into the next chapter.
Fx mesh-gradient behind it; fx svg-mask-reveal on the logo mark; fx mask-reveal on the wordmark.
Palette icon plays; the six brand swatches pop in; fx handwriting-text writes "your colours, your look".
Font specimen card and the voice card with an animated mic.
Two style cards slide in; fx marker-highlight on "look".
Four steps rise one by one (brief, concepts, identity, variants), each with a colour pictogram.
An approved stamp lands on each step; fx shake-emphasis on the stamp.
Terminal types /vf-new-video.
A brand chip, then a wide frame and a tall frame spring in (fx spring-in); a frame icon plays.
Fx code-block types the brief: for, after.
Fx ken-burns on the real page screenshot; a command tag types /vf-research.
Fx arrow-annotate: "Public page".
Fx callout: "The source" on the address.
Script card; fx marker-highlight on "three tools" and "a lost weekend".
Fx strikethrough-replace: the hype line "Unlock your productivity" becomes "Make your video".
Title; the free card with a microphone photo (fx ken-burns).
The microphone card stays; the record icon plays.
Second card: ElevenLabs; the AI-05 motion clip plays on it.
Real Studio review page screenshot scrolls to the Approved bar.
One camera move onto the Approved bar; stamp.
A typed command /vf-transcript; the CAP-06 caption clip plays; the real words appear with their times.
The times light up one by one.
A clock Lottie loops; fx timeline draws the first real cue marks.
More marks land on the time line.
Chapter title: Scene, with an animated icon.
Fx code-block types the HTML; an arrow turns it into a picture.
Wall: eight animated icons, eight colour pictograms, four Lotties (icons play on the word).
Fx zoom-through: the stock video, a stock photo and the UTL-07 music-bars clip.
A real browser recording plays (record).
Three motion-pack clips: AI-03 agent flow, CIN-01 card stack, BKG-08 ticker.
Fx sparkline-row: four effect waves (whoosh, pop, stamp, chime). Fx grid-pixelate into the next chapter.
Chips: free CC0 files, generated here.
A contact sheet of stills with the title; fx grid-pixelate lands here.
Fx spotlight moves over the contact sheet.
Fx comparison-bars: first check against now for three counters.
The counters count down to 0.
A success Lottie on the last 0.
The VID-01 player clip with the file name chip.
Three wave lines merge into one; fx gauge-dial shows the effects 3 dB under the voice.
Phone copy, thumbnail, and the chapters on an fx timeline.
Fx line-chart: the real voice level over the whole video.
Fx device-pullback: the real Studio page pulls back into a laptop.
Two real Studio pages side by side.
Fx terminal prints the real status row; fx stat-card: 5 stages done.
Fx mask-reveal: "One step. Then it stops." Step dots.
"A clear yes from you." button with fx shake-emphasis.
Fx matrix-decode on the reveal line; fx donut-chart tally of the library parts used (37 fx, 22 icons, 18 graphics, 8 Lottie, 8 clips). Fx circle-reveal into the end card.
Fx particle-field behind the logo; chips Free, Open source, MIT.
Terminal: git clone, then /vf-setup.
The repo URL pops in with fx shimmer-sweep; a confetti Lottie.
